verdict.rationale: Auth0 explicitly documents CIBA support for agent workflows: 'Using standards like CIBA (Client-Initiated Backchannel Authentication), agents can request approval for sensitive operations via push notifications, SMS, or email, even when the user is not actively using the application,' directly matching the async human-approval-for-sensitive-agent-transaction story. This is first-party vendor documentation specifically targeted at AI agent use cases (auth0.com/ai/docs), though there is no independent/hands-on corroboration or deeper implementation detail (e.g., code samples, latency/timeout behavior). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of CIBA-for-agents in practice, and detailed implementation/config documentation beyond the marketing-level description.
